subject: English
passage:
The following text is from Revathi Sundaram's 2018 novel Summer Returns. The nine-year-old narrator lives with her family in rural Mexico. Uncle Ignacio is the narrator's uncle.

Uncle Ignacio, who was the oldest in my mother's family, had moved to Canada three years ago when I was six, and I could not remember what his voice sounded like. I went into the living room to find the old cassette tapes that were stored there. But all the recordings were very old ones, made when Uncle Ignacio was a teenager or young man. Try as I might, I couldn't get an idea of what his voice sounded like now. My memory, however, was quick to fill in this gap.

©2018 by Revathi Sundaram.
prompt: According to the text, why does the narrator look for some old cassette tapes?

choices.A: She wants to use the recordings as background music for a performance she is planning.
choices.B: She is curious about what kind of music her mother enjoyed in the past.
choices.C: She hopes the recordings will help her remember what her uncle's voice sounded like.
choices.D: She wants to play a recording for her uncle when he calls on the phone.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The text states that the narrator couldn't remember what Uncle Ignacio's voice sounded like, so she went to find the old cassette tapes he was on.
